name: programming-specialists
description: Layer 1/3 — the specialists, the agents who carry the work: a coder who writes the code, refactor-first, and turns the designer's spec into the product's real UI kit — components and their Storybook, together — a reviewer who hunts the committed code across bugs/reuse/cleanliness/security, a tester who proves it across unit/integration/e2e tiers, a designer, a UI/UX agent with taste who breaks what's already designed into that spec, an independent source of design truth, a devops agent who works the project's real infrastructure directly through its own command-line tools, and a philosopher who takes apart what is brought to it — digging until the real goal is in the open, then handing back a call. Each keeps its own domain data under data/.
